//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Death Backup -> Config

Enable Death Backup.//: Whether Death Backup is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

sendBackupReminderMessageToThoseWithAcce.//: When enabled, sends a message to a player when they die and have cheat-access that a backup has been created and can be loaded.

backupReminderMessage.//: The message sent to players with cheat-access when 'sendBackupReminderMessageToThoseWithAccessOnDeath' is enabled.
backupReminderMessage.value: A backup of your inventory before your death has been created and can be loaded with '/deathbackup load 0'.
